name: Canbus → Send
description: The CAN bus can transmit frames by means of the `canbus.send` action. There are several ways to use it:

config_entries.label: Canbus ID
config_entries.description: Sets the CAN bus ID to use for transmitting the frame. Required if you are have multiple CAN bus platforms defined in your configuration.

config_entries.label: Data
config_entries.description: Data to transmit, up to eight bytes/characters are supported by CAN bus per frame.

config_entries.label: Can ID
config_entries.description: Allows overriding the `can_id` configured for the CAN bus device.

config_entries.label: Remote Transmission Request
config_entries.description: Set to send CAN bus frame to request data from another node. If a certain data length code needs to be sent, include the necessary (dummy) bytes in `data`. Defaults to `false`.
